# Motion Rules

- Motion personality: TBD
- Easing tokens: TBD
- Duration tokens: TBD
- Spring parameters: TBD
- Stagger and choreography policy: TBD

Every animation must declare purpose: feedback, state change, spatial continuity, explanation or product atmosphere.

- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Keep gesture-driven interactions responsive and interruptible.
- Avoid animating layout-heavy properties when transform/opacity can achieve the intended result.
- Do not animate decorative elements without clear product value.
- Test hover capability, touch behavior, keyboard behavior and animation failure states.
- Record frame/performance evidence for complex or continuous animations.
